# Third-party notices

SiYuan includes third-party software, fonts, data, and other resources. This document records components that are distributed with SiYuan or incorporated into its executable and browser bundles. Build-only and test-only tools are not part of this notice unless their output embeds the tool or its licensed material.

The component list is informational and does not replace the license terms. Copyright notices, license texts, and upstream NOTICE files reproduced below remain the property of their respective owners. Source links identify the corresponding upstream projects; availability of a link does not alter the applicable license.

## Go standard library and runtime

The SiYuan kernel includes the Go standard library and runtime under the Go BSD-style license. The applicable license text is reproduced below.

## Go modules incorporated into the kernel

The following inventory is the union generated by `go list -deps -json ./...` for Windows, Linux, and macOS on AMD64 and ARM64, Android mobile on ARM64, HarmonyOS's Android-compatible ARM64 and AMD64 targets, and iOS on ARM64. The release tags `fts5 sqlcipher` are applied to every target, the `mobile` tag is additionally applied to Android and iOS mobile packages, and module changes are disabled. ### app/stage/images/ai-providers/README.md

```text
# AI provider logos

The SVG files in this directory are bundled locally so the AI settings UI does not hotlink third-party assets.

The `openai.svg` file is extracted without altering its path geometry from the official [OpenAI Blossom asset](https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/3hUGLn3ypllZ0oa01qOYVq/28e8188e6f11b84c3e876569d492734f/Blossom_Light.svg) and normalized to the same 24-by-24 view box as the other provider icons. Use of the logo is subject to the [OpenAI Design Guidelines](https://openai.com/brand/).

The `deepseek.svg`, `minimax.svg`, `aliyun.svg`, `gemini.svg`, `mistral.svg`, `openrouter.svg`, `ollama.svg`, and `lmstudio.svg` files come from [Simple Icons 16.21.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/16.21.0). The `moonshot.svg` file comes from [Simple Icons 16.27.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/16.27.0/icons/moonshotai.svg). Monochrome logos are rendered with the corresponding brand colors recorded in the Simple Icons metadata. Simple Icons is distributed under CC0-1.0, but the depicted logos remain trademarks of their respective owners and should be used according to each brand's guidelines.

The `zhipu.svg` file is extracted from the 24-by-24 `pure-logo.svg` symbol bundled by the official [Zhipu AI Open Platform](https://www.bigmodel.cn/). The `siliconflow.svg` file preserves the path geometry of the single-graphic SVG in the official [SiliconFlow logo package](https://siliconflow.cn/brand) and normalizes its transparent margins to a 24-by-24 view box.

The `volcengine.svg` file comes from [theSVG](https://github.com/glincker/thesvg/blob/aa0605996b4ad4fdda98502f84021b3c3a64847d/public/icons/volcengine/default.svg), distributed under the MIT license. The depicted logo remains a trademark of Volcengine.

Groq uses a generated initial avatar because its [trademark policy](https://groq.com/trademark-policy) limits nominative fair use to its word marks and excludes logos. Custom providers also use generated initial avatars.
```
